RESPECT & SAFETY

Boundaries matter

Privacy-focused

Booking information should be handled responsibly. Confidentiality can have lawful and serious-safety limits.

Offline safety

Offline sessions are intended for cafés, co-working spaces or other suitable public places in Mumbai.

Not medical care

We do not diagnose, prescribe medication, provide clinical treatment or replace qualified professionals.

POLICIES

Clear terms & boundaries

Privacy Policy

Collect only information needed for booking and communication. Users should not submit passwords, OTPs, banking credentials or unnecessary identity documents.

Terms & Conditions

Users must provide accurate details and respect listeners. Harassment, fraud, illegal activity, exploitation and abusive behaviour are not permitted.

Cancellation & Refund

Publish an exact cancellation, rescheduling and refund window before payment. Final wording should be reviewed for your business and applicable law.

Emergency Disclaimer

Heart to Heart is not an emergency service. For immediate danger or urgent medical/mental-health needs, contact emergency services or a qualified professional.

Confidentiality

Sessions are intended to be private, subject to applicable law and serious safety situations. Do not promise absolute confidentiality.

Age & minors

Set a clear minimum age and guardian rules before launch. Add stronger safeguards if minors are permitted.
